hooks.prompt:
Before allowing this command to expand, verify the prerequisite EDM HITL gate has been approved for the named initiative. The user is invoking $ARGUMENTS. The command hook running alongside this prompt already enforces this deterministically -- this prompt is an advisory second layer, not the primary check, so it must resolve the SAME gate the binary would rather than hardcode one.

Procedure:
1. Extract the initiative PREFIX from the first argument.
2. If the PREFIX is empty or contains any character other than a letter, digit, hyphen or underscore, this is a malformed prefix argument, NOT a legitimate first invocation -- BLOCK the expansion with the same `[EDM] invalid prefix` diagnostic the command hook uses.
3. Otherwise run `edm-state resolve-dir <PREFIX>`; if it fails (no initiative found yet for an otherwise well-formed PREFIX), this is a legitimate first invocation -- allow expansion.
4. Otherwise run `edm-state gate-check <PREFIX> srd` (resolves the correct gate number from the initiative's mode and skipped_phases -- never hardcode one here). If it exits non-zero, BLOCK the expansion and show the user its stderr diagnostic verbatim (it already names the missing gate and the exact remediation command). If it exits 0, allow expansion.

hooks.command: command -v edm-state >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; command -v edm-lint-artifacts >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; srd_root_explicit=0; [ -n "${EDM_SRD_ROOT:-}" ] && srd_root_explicit=1; [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SRD_ROOT:-}" ] && srd_root_explicit=1; srd_root="${EDM_SRD_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SRD_ROOT:-./SRD}}"; repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); while [ "${srd_root#./}" != "$srd_root" ]; do srd_root="${srd_root#./}"; done; case "$srd_root" in /*) relativized=""; if [ -n "$repo_root" ]; then case "$srd_root" in "$repo_root") relativized="." ;; "$repo_root"/*) relativized="${srd_root#"$repo_root"/}" ;; esac; fi; if [ -n "$relativized" ]; then srd_root="$relativized"; else echo "[EDM] srd_root is absolute (${srd_root}) and could not be relativized under the repository root${repo_root:+ (${repo_root})}; commit-time artifact lint cannot match repository-relative staged paths -- set EDM_SRD_ROOT to a repo-relative path or run edm-lint-artifacts manually" >&2; exit 1; fi ;; esac; while :; do case "$srd_root" in */) srd_root="${srd_root%/}" ;; */.) srd_root="${srd_root%/.}" ;; *) break ;; esac; done; case "$srd_root" in ""|.) srd_root="." ;; ..|../*|*/..|*/../*) echo "[EDM] srd_root (${srd_root}) resolves outside the repository root (contains a '..' path component); commit-time artifact lint cannot match repository-relative staged paths -- set EDM_SRD_ROOT to a repo-relative path or run edm-lint-artifacts manually" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; check_dir="${repo_root:-.}/${srd_root}"; if [ ! -d "$check_dir" ]; then if [ "$srd_root_explicit" -eq 1 ]; then echo "[EDM] srd_root (${srd_root}) does not exist -- commit-time artifact lint has nothing to scan; check EDM_SRD_ROOT / CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SRD_ROOT for a typo" >&2; exit 1; fi; exit 0; fi; staged=$(git -c diff.relative=false diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); test -z "$staged" && exit 0; root_for_awk="$srd_root"; [ "$root_for_awk" = "." ] && root_for_awk=""; prefixes=$(echo "$staged" | root="$root_for_awk" awk '{ if (ENVIRON["root"] == "") { rest = $0 } else { rl = length(ENVIRON["root"]) + 1; if (substr($0,1,rl) == (ENVIRON["root"] "/")) { rest = substr($0, rl+1) } else { next } } n = split(rest, parts, "/"); if (n>=2 && parts[2] ~ /__/) { p=parts[2]; sub(/__.*/, "", p); print p } else if (n>=1 && parts[1] ~ /^[A-Z]/) { print parts[1] } }' | grep -E '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_-]*$' | sort -u); test -z "$prefixes" && exit 0; fail=0; for p in $prefixes; do EDM_SRD_ROOT="$check_dir" edm-state resolve-dir "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; out=$(EDM_SRD_ROOT="$check_dir" edm-lint-artifacts "$p" 2>&1); code=$?; if [ "$code" -eq 1 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; echo "[EDM] Fix artifact violations before committing (edm-lint-artifacts $p)" >&2; fail=2; elif [ "$code" -eq 2 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; echo "[EDM] edm-lint-artifacts setup/usage error for $p -- not blocking the commit; investigate separately" >&2; fi; done; exit $fail

hooks.prompt:
An edm-implementer subagent just completed. Spawn an edm-qc-auditor agent to verify acceptance criteria for the tickets just implemented in that subagent's work.

Instructions for the spawned edm-qc-auditor:
1. Read the relevant epic file to get ticket ACs.
2. For each AC, classify as statically-verifiable or runtime-only before grading.
3. Assign PASS (statically verified), PARTIAL (runtime-only, with runtime-check: note), or FAIL (statically unmet).
4. Resolve the initiative directory from state using `edm-state resolve-dir <PREFIX>`.
5. Write the QC report to `<initiative-dir>/qc/qc-summary.md` (run `mkdir -p <initiative-dir>/qc` first).
6. For each PARTIAL verdict, call `edm-state record-partial-verdict <PREFIX> <ticket> PARTIAL '<note>'` to persist it.
7. Report PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL per ticket with file:line evidence.
